scripts.check:csp: node -e "const fs=process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs');let bad=0;for(const f of ['apps/web/dist/index.html'])for(const m of fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').match(/<script\\b[^>]*>/gi)||[])if(!/\\ssrc=/i.test(m)){bad++;console.error('INLINE <script> in '+f+': '+m)}if(bad){console.error('The deployed CSP is script-src self with no unsafe-inline, so those '+bad+' inline script(s) would be blocked and the app would render blank in production.');process.exit(1)}console.log('OK - no inline <script> in built HTML')"
scripts.//verify: Everything CI runs that a laptop can run without extra installs (19 August 2026). Stays CI-only, with the reason: web-touch, screens, pwa-update and the parity gates need a Playwright browser plus (for parity) an Expo export — react-smoke and deploy-smoke are kept here because they skip cleanly without a browser, the others hard-require one; the remaining contract suites (pentest, supabase-contract, whoop-contract, concept2-contract, supabase-auth) live in CI's post-build contract loop as one unit — whoop-contract's secret scan sweeps the BUILT bundles, and splitting the loop across two lists is how the two drift. The full list and each reason live in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
scripts.verify: node checks/docs.mjs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:ecosystem && node checks/coach-contract.mjs && node checks/contrast.mjs && node checks/mobile-touch.mjs && node checks/whoop-deployment-smoke.mjs && node checks/migrations-apply.mjs && pnpm run check:reachability && pnpm run check:css-state && pnpm run build:site && pnpm run check:csp && pnpm run smoke && pnpm run smoke:deploy
